dedupe_keys.name: anac inventory of assets of concession airports brazil

description: Brazil's civil aviation agency ANAC publishes, as open data, the inventory of assets that concessionaires of federal airports report to it: a register of every asset of each airport concession. Each row gives the airport (ICAO code), how the asset entered the concession (transferred by the state, bought directly or through an EPC contract), asset code and description (model, capacity, voltage and similar), whether it is usable and whether it reverts to the state, accounting account, acquisition and in-service dates, depreciation start, estimated useful life in years, quantity, acquisition cost in reais, accumulated depreciation, movements (entries, disposals, transfers between airports) with sale values, and the inventory year. Coverage is national for the conceded airports, with inventory years from 2020 in the file. The data are free to download as CSV (about 43 MB) and JSON (about 143 MB) from ANAC's open data server, refreshed annually (last update 1 August 2026); the licence is not stated on the pages read. Caveats: only conceded airports are included, asset descriptions are free text from each concessionaire, and there are no coordinates. The inventory supports asset condition and ageing analysis, replacement cost estimates and exposure studies of airport equipment. It complements the ANAC air transport statistics.
